01_quickstart: Save HTML with one convert() call and receive a Document.
02_files_unicode: Use UTF-8 input, Korean/Japanese/accented text, and exact output extensions.
03_existing_document: Append content to a Document and insert HTML into table cells.
04_inline_formatting: Apply emphasis, underline, strike, scripts, code, and alpha-composited colors.
05_stylesheets: Combine style tags, explicit external CSS loading, selectors, inheritance, and important precedence.
06_word_styles: Map HTML classes to public style constants and custom character styles.
07_page_layout: Set alignment, spacing, indentation, line height, and page breaks.
08_tables: Combine table sections, row/column spans, cell backgrounds, width, borders, and nesting.
09_lists: Use start values, li values, independent restarts, and nested numbered/bulleted lists.
10_data_images: Place data URL images inside a paragraph and set their display width.
11_local_images: Read files below an explicit base directory; paths outside it are refused.
12_asset_loader: Resolve logical asset IDs to bytes and insert BytesIO images into cells.
13_mathml: Create editable fractions, scripts, indexed roots, delimiters, matrices, and inline equations.
14_latex: Use the optional frontend for sums, fractions, roots, and matrices.
15_markers: Replace markers spanning formatted runs and insert multiple blocks into cells.
16_bookmarks: Replace Word bookmark ranges while preserving surrounding content and bookmarks.
17_docxtpl: Render a Jinja template and then add HTML paragraphs.
18_options: Disable images, tables, math, or styles and independently copy settings.
19_style_helpers: Explicitly apply CSS text to a target run or paragraph.
20_links: Use external/internal links, id/name anchors, and links without href.
21_report: Combine stylesheets, images, merged tables, nested lists, equations, and page breaks.
22_markdown: Convert headings, tables, lists, code, and strikethrough with the optional frontend.
23_complex_equations: Compare 20 authored MathML and 24 LaTeX examples covering nested fractions, matrices, calculus, accents, and math alphabets.
24_dense_report: Combine 120 equation placements with merged/nested tables, lists, images, links, multilingual text, and page breaks.
25_research_report: Ten distinct advanced MathML formulas with Korean/English prose, merged and nested tables, lists, images, links, and page breaks.
26_template_workbook: Put the same advanced formulas into existing documents and table cells; combine marker replacement, nested tables, headers, footers, and a landscape page.
27_advanced_latex: Eight distinct advanced LaTeX inputs exercise adjacent matrices, grouped powers, piecewise expressions, nested radicals, sums, and derivatives inside a formatted report.
